newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Kleinwort completes 1997 stock list.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kleinwort completes 1997 stock list.

text.p: Banking group Barclays Plc and insurer Prudential Corp Plc were on Friday added to the 1997 stock selection list at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, strategist Phillip Isherwood at the brokerage said.
Barclays shares were up 2-1/2p at 10.59 stg, after earlier reaching a record 10.72 stg, while the Pru was up 2p at 507-1/2p after reaching a record 510p.

After outperforming the UK stock market through 1996, banking shares have seen further sharp gains this week amid hopes for strong profit growth in forthcoming results and talk of further share buybacks.
Isherwood said Barclays was favoured because of its commitment to returning capital to shareholders rather than increasing its loan book.
He said Pru shares should benefit from new business growth and the release of surplus or "orphan" funds from its investment holdings.
Both stocks should also gain from a benign economic backdrop, Isherwood said, with the brokerage positive on the outlook for gilts through 1997.
The addition of Barclays and the Pru completes Kleinwort's pick of ten UK stocks expected to outperform the market through the coming year, rolled out two-a-day since Monday.
The other eight on the list were P&O Plc, Pearson Plc, National Grid Plc, Bass Plc, DFS Furniture Plc, Safeway Plc, TT Group Plc and Johnson Matthey Plc.
